summary: Structured prescription-corpus intake: the 60 question→prescription pairs in .zcode/kb-prescriptions-2026-09-12/prescriptions.json enter the registry as 60 active entries under the prescription.* namespace, with the normalize-review.json merges applied. All 51 v11 entries are copied byte-identical (same entry_id, entry_version, fields and text); the 92 v11 sources are copied byte-identical and 30 new coach_first_party Bilibili sources are appended. Each new entry states the problem raw plus tags, the prescription raw with its scenario|method|mixed type, the three-state scenario availability (local / official with leaderboard_id / unresolved-as-transcribed), the video title plus source_file plus verbatim quote as provenance, and the confidence label. Community material stays at community_practice except low-confidence pairs, which are experimental; the medical red line is carried by the ergonomics entries and not asserted here. registry_version advances to 2026-09-12.v12; schema_version stays coach_knowledge_registry.v3; v11 remains loadable as history.

capability_discipline.community_paraphrase_ceiling: corpus prescription content stays community_practice; low-confidence pairs are pinned to experimental
capability_discipline.confidence_fidelity: each entry's limitations names the source confidence honestly (high/medium/low); no confidence is upgraded or dropped
capability_discipline.scenario_availability_fidelity: local names are given as locally openable, official names carry their leaderboard_id, unresolved names are written as transcription-uncertain and never presented as a canonical official scenario
capability_discipline.deterministic_query_boundary: prescription.* entries are Coach-facing recommendation content and are excluded from query_registry, so diagnosis/advice candidate top-3 annotations and the advice expected_entry_ref gate are unchanged from v11
capability_discipline.medical_red_line: The prescription corpus adds no body/medical claims; persistent pain, numbness, or weakness still stops training and is referred to a doctor or rehabilitation professional.

added_entries.normalization_merge: .zcode/kb-prescriptions-2026-09-12/normalize-review.json (28 raw→normalized rows applied; scenarios upgrading unresolved→official: 42)
added_entries.topics_note: topics use the 32 problem tags verbatim (aligned to v11 topics vocabulary plus the corpus's self-coined kebab-case tags). New tags outside the v11 topic vocabulary are limited to the four the README already calls out (fine-micro-adjustment, practice-plan-structure, tremor-control, wrist-health); the rest are recombinations of existing v11 family/subdomain words.
added_entries.signals_note: signals map each tag to the analyzer's canonical signal words (decel_frac, reverse_ratio, sparc, correction burden, tracking lag, post change error, switch transition, etc.); tags with no analyzer signal leave signals empty and are matched through metric_refs/topics instead.

added_sources.note: Each new corpus video is registered as community.prescription.<bv-id> at source_level coach_first_party, applicability all_families, supporting all eight prescription sections. 29 corpus videos already existed in v11 and are reused rather than duplicated.

audited_unchanged.note: All 51 v11 entries are copied byte-identical; no entry_version change, no field change, no text change.
The 92 v11 sources and the signal_aliases map are byte-identical; the 30 new sources are appended.
query_registry skips the prescription.* namespace, so diagnosis/advice knowledge_entry_refs stay at the v11 top-3.

approval.scope: 处方语料入库：60 条新增、30 个新来源、v12 版本推进；基于老板给定的 prescriptions.json + normalize-review.json 生成
approval.note: 训练推荐链路最后一环，接入 Coach 知识体系
